 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Thus, among the given options the correct word to use is "unmatched."**
 
• "Unmatched" means something not matched or equalled.
 
 
• Example: That is a work ethic unmatched by any modern British group.
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the correct word to use in the blank is "unmatched."
